# C2PA sample images

`C.jpg` (Content Credentials that match the content) and `XCA.jpg` (content changed after signing) are test images
from the C2PA reference library, [contentauth/c2pa-rs](https://github.com/contentauth/c2pa-rs/tree/main/sdk/tests/fixtures),
used under its MIT / Apache-2.0 licence. They are signed with the library's test certificate.
